answer: An agent economy in an orchard resists Sybil attacks via acoustic beamforming and spatial binning. Within a short time horizon, a microphone array broadcasts a radio nonce, and agents reply at whisper volume with chirps encoding signed responses. Delay-and-sum beamforming bins replies by angle and admits one key per sector. Because co-located keys share a sector, attackers must build, power, and disperse transmitters per identity, though wind or trunk echoes skew bearings and block honest nodes.
